about_the_game:
Minute Man is a 2D beat 'em up platformer game where you can freeze time as you're fighting enemies to secure an advantage. Fight through various waves of enemies and defeat bosses in several levels, keeping time frozen as you chain combos against your enemies!

Fight seven different clans, each containing waves of enemies and a boss you must defeat. Each clan has a unique method of combat, so be prepared!

Freeze time as you fight your enemies, using the time to secure an advantage. Time stays frozen longer as you land hits on your enemies, so be sure to stay on the attack!

Coming soon.
detailed_description:
April Demo Released!

Hello Folks! I've released a first demo of Minute Man that contains a tutorial and a single level to play through that will hopefully show off the game. Nothing in this demo should be taken as finalized - this game is very early in its development, and will likely not be released until closer to the end of the year. I plan on making several improvements and revisions alongside additional levels as I continue working on this game. I hope you enjoy it!
